name: Minai Tomoe
source:
Minai Tomoe is the main protagonist of Someutsushi-hen, Kageboushi-hen, Tokihogushi-hen, and Miotsukushi-hen. Tomoe is a new police officer and detective who investigates the curse of Oyashiro-sama and the Great Hinamizawa Disaster. She later gets deeply involved in Natsumi's problems through her investigation. She has a sister, [url=/c71712]Minai Madoka[/url], who is also a police officer.

[Edited from [url=http://whentheycry.wikia.com/wiki/Minai_Tomoe]Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Wiki[/url]]
